summary: Verified (1) Ficha Técnica PDF prints the FROZEN project.created_at date (in Spanish) instead of today's date, and (2) 'Seleccionar Destinatarios' modal groups contacts by scope (grupo/principal/local) with visible bordered section headers. Backend: 2/2 pytest tests passed (specific project prj_826643491b64 shows '29 de abril de 2026' and 2 additional past-dated projects also show their created_at date, none show today '30 de agosto de 2026'). Frontend: opened the modal via Cotizaciones → Acciones → 'Enviar al Cliente' on a PYME quote (COT-2026-08-213-PYME, quo_dfe914fd9f16 — AHA GROUP TECHNOLOGY). Modal renders data-testid='contact-select-modal' with grouped container 'contact-select-groups' and section 'contact-group-principal' having header 'RIF PRINCIPAL (1)'. Checkbox 'contact-checkbox-0' toggles counter from '0 seleccionado(s)' to '1 seleccionado(s)' correctly. This client only has principal-scope contacts, so 'grupo' and 'local' sections are correctly hidden. Cancelar/Continuar buttons present.

issues: Console hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' — pre-existing React hydration errors in QuotesTable, not related to this iteration but flagged for cleanup

critical_code_review_comments: QuoteModals.jsx (~509) modal grouping implementation is clean and defensive (renders only non-empty scope sections; falls back to 'principal' when scope missing). Good use of data-testid on each group.
implementation_pdf.py fallback to today when ficha_emission_date is missing is acceptable, but consider logging a warning when the fallback triggers to detect stale/incomplete quotes.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing prj_826643491b64 (created_at=2026-04-29) and quote quo_dfe914fd9f16 (AHA GROUP PYME).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes validated. Backend test file test_iter334_ficha_frozen_date.py extracts PDF text with pypdf and asserts Spanish frozen-date format. Frontend modal 'contact-select-modal' groups contacts under 'contact-group-grupo|principal|local' with headers 'Grupo Económico', 'RIF Principal', 'Sucursal' respectively; sections only render if they contain rows. Note: to click the quote-actions dropdown reliably on /quotes I had to dispatch PointerEvent+Mouse events via page.evaluate — Playwright's locator.click(force=True) intermittently times out (likely due to virtualized rows in QuotesTable), so future testers should use dispatchEvent fallback.
rca of the issue: N/A — both fixes verified working. Ficha Técnica now uses quote['ficha_emission_date']=project.created_at in generate_implementation_pdf. Modal groups by (c.scope || 'principal') across ['grupo','principal','local'].
